source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 16 iunie — «Sfântul Sfinţit Mucenic Marcu, Episcopul Apoloniadei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Μάρκος Ιερομάρτυρας επίσκοπος Απολλωνιάδος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It is plainly the same man: the hieromartyr bishop of Apollonias whom the folder's Romanian row already keeps on 16 June, and saint.gr adds the manner of his death. It gives no year. He is none of the corpus's other men named Mark. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
